COZY RALLY  v0.1 (early preview)
================================
Double-click CozyRally.exe. No install needed.
(Windows SmartScreen may warn because the exe is unsigned: More info -> Run anyway.)

CONTROLS
  Drive ............ W A S D  or  arrow keys
  Handbrake ........ Space
  Respawn .......... R
  Camera ........... C
  Pause ............ Esc / P
  Menus ............ mouse, or arrows + Enter

SPLIT-SCREEN (2 players, one keyboard)
  Player 1: W A S D, Space = handbrake, R = respawn, C = camera
  Player 2: Arrows, Right Shift = handbrake, Backspace = respawn, Right Ctrl = camera

Every seed makes a new track. Try the different scenery and cars!
Not yet in this preview: sound, particles, online multiplayer (coming next).
